title: warrant.verify-report@v0 (SPEC §11)
description: The machine-readable verification report. CLOSED SCHEMA: exactly seven top-level members and exactly {level, subject, message} per finding. Two guarantees this schema CANNOT express and a consumer MUST still check: errors == |ERR findings|, warnings == |WARN findings| (§11.1 counts-bind-findings), and ok == (errors == 0). It also cannot express §11.2 (one physical line, empty stderr, exit status parity).

subject.description: A full hex64 WarrantID, or a reserved subject from the §13.3 registry: "store" or "settlement". Consumers MUST NOT assume hex64.

message.description: NON-NORMATIVE human prose. MAY differ between conformant implementations for the same input; a consumer MUST NOT branch on it.
